name: Fuling
source:
A monster girl who claims to be the reincarnation of the auspicious beast Bai Ze. She is has an airheaded personality and likes to suddenly appear out of nowhere to startle others.

She likes to drink very much, but also has an unexpectedly low alcohol tolerance. It's often that she's seen in a state of drunkenness.

She seems to know about the unknown past, but never can tell it. She also has a wonderful secret.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630/_/]Steam[/url]]
